title: Reliable roster opening and recovery
summary: Give a slow shared roster time to recover, keep activity from blocking entry, and make both recovery actions dependable.
changes: A realistic startup window for a slow or cold shared database connection.
Recent activity history that can no longer block entry to Night, Changes or Breaks.
A visible Try again state and a repaired, explicitly read-only saved-roster fallback while the shared connection is unavailable.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, realtime, privacy or database rules.
